tasks.label: Smoke test FastAPI account and expense CRUD
args: import os,tempfile; os.environ.pop('DATABASE_URL',None); os.environ['EXPENSES_DB']=tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db'); from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from app.main import app; client=TestClient(app); r=client.post('/api/auth/register',json={'username':'vercel-smoke','password':'test-password-123'}); assert r.status_code==201,(r.status_code,r.text); token=r.json()['access_token']; assert client.post('/api/auth/register',json={'username':'VERCEL-SMOKE','password':'other-password'}).status_code==409; assert client.post('/api/auth/login',json={'username':'vercel-smoke','password':'test-password-123'}).status_code==200; payload={'title':'Test','amount':12.5,'category':'Food & drink','spent_at':'2026-10-20','notes':''}; h={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token}; e=client.post('/api/expenses',json=payload,headers=h); assert e.status_code==201,(e.status_code,e.text); eid=e.json()['id']; assert len(client.get('/api/expenses',headers=h).json())==1; u=client.put('/api/expenses/'+str(eid),json={**payload,'title':'Updated'},headers=h); assert u.status_code==200 and u.json()['title']=='Updated',(u.status_code,u.text); assert client.delete('/api/expenses/'+str(eid),headers=h).status_code==204; print('API smoke passed: register, duplicate prevention, login, and expense CRUD')
